verdict.rationale: Base44 docs mention that each app has a "sandbox" that agents/scripts can connect to (base44-docs-3), and the CLI's clone/eject command creates a separate project with its own app ID and copied data (base44-docs-1/22), which could serve as an isolated test environment. However, there is no dedicated documentation describing a staging/sandbox mode that explicitly guarantees production data isolation or a workflow for testing changes safely before deploying to production. missing for 10: explicit staging environment docs, guarantees that sandbox data is separate from live production data, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this isolation.
